Name: Ani's Cute Wallpapers and Floors
Author: GrannyAni
Description:
[size=2]
[/size][center][size=6][b][CP] Ani's Cute Wallpapers & Floors[/b][/size][/center][size=3]
This mod adds a collection of cute wallpapers and floors for the interior of your home using Content Patcher. The pack includes 96 wallpapers and 16 different floors. With a pink, blue and purple version (32 wallpapers, 4 floors each in each version) It hopefully provides enough variety for most players! There are many cute wallpaper mods on Nexus already and I wanted to attempt my own, I hope anyone who downloads this mod enjoys using it!

[size=5]Download information
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If not already done, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] on your device[/size]
[*][size=3]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, since this is a pack for content patcher[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the file from this mod page, and then unzip the files into your mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]If these steps have been done correctly, run the game as normal and it should work! [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Notes and other information
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]This mod can only be found on Nexus mods, if you find it uploaded anywhere [/size][size=3]else, please inform me and don't download this mod from any other [/size][size=3]websites.[/size]
[*][size=3]This mod is NOT for alternative textures. I most likely won't be making a version for alternative textures since I'm honestly not sure how to, as I am no longer as active on the Stardew Valley modding space as I used to be. [/size]
[/list][/size][size=5]

[/size]
